subject.archetype: <Species + Role combination defining the silhouette and basic traits (e.g., Cyborg Hacker, Augmented Soldier)>

loadout.armor_outfit: <Materials, cut, and style of clothing or protection (e.g., Tactical exoskeleton, armored space suit)>
loadout.arsenal: <Primary/secondary weapons or equipped gadgets (e.g., Plasma rifle, high-frequency blade, companion drone)>

attitude.behavior: <Description of physical action and posture (e.g., Hovering with a jetpack, crouching while hacking a terminal)>
attitude.emotion: <Description of the actual feeling of the subject (e.g., Cold cybernetic stare, extreme focus under a HUD visor)>

palette_names.name: <Color 1 name (e.g., Neon Cyan)>
palette_names.role: <Role in the image (e.g., light accent, background)>

scenography.setting: <The physical location or background environment (e.g., Neon-lit megacity, abandoned ship corridor)>
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: <Weather conditions, lighting, and special effects linked to the action (e.g., Acid rain, glitching holograms, blue energy shield)>
